令狐冲的怪病治好了！.en: Hippocrates completed Musashi's treatment. Lingering Cough is gone.
令狐冲的怪病治好了！.zh-CN: 希波克拉底完成了对武藏的治疗，久咳已经消退。

圣姑有点想她爹了，让令狐冲去看看.en: Tomoe says Oda Nobunaga wants to see Musashi at Black Pine Cliff. Visit when you're ready.
圣姑有点想她爹了，让令狐冲去看看.zh-CN: 巴御前说，织田信长想在黑松崖见武藏。准备好后，可以前往拜访。

text.en: There you are. I followed the sound of someone refusing to rest.
text.zh-CN: 总算找到你了。听着有人不肯休息的动静，一路找来的。

text.en: Tomoe? How did you find us?
text.zh-CN: 巴御前？你怎么找到这里的？

text.en: A swordsman coughing his way across the countryside is not difficult to track.
text.zh-CN: 一个咳嗽着走遍乡间的剑客，可不难找。

text.en: Besides, your idea of a quiet recovery seems to involve an audience.
text.zh-CN: 而且，你所谓的静养，好像还得配一群观众。

text.en: The audience was the doctor's idea. I think.
text.zh-CN: 观众是医师安排的。大概吧。

text.en: Then listen to the doctor for once.
text.zh-CN: 那这回，就好好听医师的话。

text.en: He has been listening. The treatment is missing one last ingredient.
text.zh-CN: 他已经在听了。只是治疗，还差最后一味材料。

text.en: Yes. He told every innkeeper on the road. It saved me a great deal of searching.
text.zh-CN: 知道，他沿路把这事告诉了每位旅店老板，倒是省了我不少找人的工夫。

text.en: A remarkably effective form of diagnosis.
text.zh-CN: 真是很有效的问诊方式。

text.en: I brought the Frostsilk. You can stop making it sound like a lost kingdom.
text.zh-CN: 我带来了霜蚕丝。不用再把它说得像失落的王国一样难找。

text.en: You found it? I was beginning to think the cough would outlive me.
text.zh-CN: 你找到了？我都快以为，这咳嗽会比我活得还久。

text.en: Good. That's the final component. Now I can prepare the treatment.
text.zh-CN: 很好，最后一味也齐了。现在可以开始配药调治。

text.en: A warrior with the right supplies. My favorite kind of reinforcement.
text.zh-CN: 一位带齐所需材料的战士。我最喜欢这样的援军。

text.en: Before you reach for your swords, we need to discuss what comes next.
text.zh-CN: 先别急着拿剑，我们得谈谈接下来的打算。

text.en: Must we? I was hoping the medicine came with a little freedom.
text.zh-CN: 一定要现在谈吗？我还盼着，吃完药就能自在些。

text.en: It comes with recovery.
text.zh-CN: 吃完药，接着就是养病。

text.en: That sounds suspiciously like a schedule.
text.zh-CN: 听起来，很像一份作息安排。

text.en: Rest first. Then we travel together. No racing off to prove you're cured.
text.zh-CN: 先休养，再一起上路。别为了证明自己好了，转身就跑去比武。

text.en: Travel together?
text.zh-CN: 一起上路？

text.en: You make that sound harder than fighting.
text.zh-CN: 让你说得，好像比打架还难。

text.en: Not harder. Less familiar. I could use someone who tells me when to stop.
text.zh-CN: 倒不是难，只是不大习惯。有人提醒我适可而止，也挺好。

text.en: Good. Though I don't intend to spend every day chasing you down.
text.zh-CN: 那就好。不过，我可不打算每天都满世界追着你跑。

text.en: Circe, you've heard her. Is there a spell for listening?
text.zh-CN: 喀耳刻，你也听到了。有让人好好听劝的法术吗？

text.en: For that, I recommend rest. Actual rest, not 'very slow sword practice.'
text.zh-CN: 这事我建议靠休息。真正的休息，不是“慢一点练剑”。

text.en: Will that keep him out of trouble?
text.zh-CN: 这样就能让他少惹点麻烦？

text.en: Unlikely. Once he's breathing properly, he'll find twice as many duels to volunteer for.
text.zh-CN: 恐怕不行。等呼吸顺了，他大概会找来两倍的比武，抢着参加。

text.en: Then I'll come along. Someone should insist he survives the victory celebration.
text.zh-CN: 那我就同行吧。总得有人确保，他能平安度过自己的庆功。

text.en: I was planning a modest one.
text.zh-CN: 我本来只打算，稍微庆祝一下。

text.en: Good. We'll begin by putting the swords down.
text.zh-CN: 很好。那就从放下剑开始。

text.en: Thank you, Tomoe. For the medicine, and for coming.
text.zh-CN: 谢谢你，巴御前。谢谢你的药，也谢谢你愿意来。

text.en: Save the speech. You'll need that breath for recovering.
text.zh-CN: 长篇大论就省了吧。留点气力，好好养病。

text.en: Fifteen days of treatment and rest later...
text.zh-CN: 治疗并休养了十五天后……

text.en: A full breath, and not a cough. Tomoe, I think I'm ready for the road.
text.zh-CN: 一口气吸到底，也不咳嗽了。巴御前，我想可以上路了。

text.en: Oda Nobunaga wants a word with you at Black Pine Cliff. We should stop by when we can.
text.zh-CN: 织田信长想在黑松崖见你。方便的时候，我们去一趟吧。

text.en: Then we'll make time for him. Together.
text.zh-CN: 那就找时间，一起去见他。
